image_description: A chunky, statement necklace displayed on a black velvet jewelry bust. The necklace consists of large, irregular, translucent amber or resin-like segments connected by silver-toned metal links and wire-wrapping. The segments vary in shape, resembling polished stones or organic forms.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the black bust is extremely uniform and lacks the micro-variations typical of real velvet fabric under close inspection, appearing slightly 'smudged' or digitally painted.

The silver wire wrapping around the amber segments appears somewhat illogical in places; some wires seem to merge into the bead surface without a clear physical anchor point, suggesting slight AI generation ambiguity in complex mechanical details.
The geometry of the rightmost large segment seems slightly warped, lacking a consistent light reflection plane compared to adjacent segments.

To verify the physical connectivity between the metal wires and the amber segments, ensuring no floating parts or impossible fusions.
To assess the realism of the velvet texture and lighting reflections on the semi-translucent beads.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping details. AI often struggles with thin, winding metal structures, causing them to melt into the main object or float. Verify if the physics of the hanging segments makes sense given gravity.
